title: I need help
description: Practice asking for help together. One of you is the child, one is the parent. You will each pick a sign, then confirm it together.
situation: You are playing at the park and you fall and scrape your knee. You want to tell a grown-up you need help.

steps.prompt: Read the situation together out loud.
Parent: look at the reference sign for I need help. This is a placeholder picture, not a verified ISL recording yet.
Child: pick the card that matches what you want to say.
Both of you: check this is the message you want to send.
Well done! You practiced asking for help together. Come back and try it again any time.
